origins.description: base URL of each role of the system pack

allow_plaintext.description: origins (scheme://host[:port]) whose plain HTTP may carry credentials

settings.description: non-secret deployment values handed to the read functions as input.settings

concurrency.description: requests in flight at once, default 2

interval_ms.description: least time between two request starts, default 0

timeout_ms.description: per request unless the route says otherwise, default 30000

read_only.description: the target's help tool never presses Enter on the asked line and always clears it (D02 R[4]: read-only enforced by the target); certified per target version

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer; the empty string is the whole value
RFC 6901 JSON Pointer; the empty string is the whole value

stage.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer; the empty string is the whole value

reached_device.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer; the empty string is the whole value

sessions.description: optional per-item evidence; successful cases may omit sessions; never a prerequisite for a device verdict

items.description: response-root pointer to the item array

item_id.description: pointer relative to one item, not the response root

item_outcome.description: pointer relative to one item, not the response root; its exact scalar must be declared in result.map

text.description: the target's description of the asked position, a string; absent, null or empty: it described nothing

caret_only.description: boolean: the target answered with nothing but a caret under the line

entered.description: boolean: whether Enter was pressed on the asked line; must read false

cleared.description: boolean: whether the input line was cleared again; must read true
